seller_or_subject: Change.org petition — 100+ sellers collectively demand payment, 4,070 signatures (OUT OF WINDOW — Mar 2020)
what: Roberto Marina creates collective petition on behalf of 100+ Kichink sellers demanding payment for sales completed through the platform, reporting that in 2019 the platform stopped operating as promised and payment delays began.
verbatim_snippet: "Somos mas de 100 empresarios / emprendedores que estamos exigiendo nuestros pagos, mismos que fueron ventas que realizamos a través de la plataforma de comercio electrónico KICHINK. En el año 2019, dejaron de operar de la forma en la que nos prometieron."
notes: OUT OF WINDOW. Petition closed with 4,070 signatures. Creator: Roberto Marina. Collective voice, 100+ sellers. Petition also states a circulating document tallying retained payments exceeding 500,000 pesos. Source directly accessed and verified.
